nodes.ragnoslawa.text.t: Ragnosława lies face to the sky, with the look of someone who took offence at everything in advance. In her bag are clean bandages, and round her neck a worn tin guard's token. You take both, because the living can use them.

nodes.rozejrzenie.text.t: The morning is insolently calm. The grass steams with dew, and in it lie the ones you shared a pot with yesterday. Beside them their bundles, strewn about as if after a robbery, and one more: a stranger's, dropped mid-stride. The guide isn't among the bodies. The bastard bolted as soon as things got hot.

nodes.skarimir.text.t: Skarimir still has a dagger clutched in his fist. He never got his supper. You prise his stiff fingers open; he has no more use for the dagger, but you might.

nodes.tobolek.text.t: The guide ran so fast he even left his bundle behind. From the bottom of it you dig out a greasy sketch of the road: a river, a ford, a watchtower and a path into the forest that someone marked just in case. The devil took the guide, but the map stayed.

nodes.wojmir.text.t: Wojmir had more brains than brawn, and neither did him any good today. In his bundle: rations for two days, an inkpot and a pen.
